entities.name: great old willow on the bank by the jetty (leaning trunk, knobbed head)
entities.what: Huge old willow: a thick, twisted, knotted trunk rises from the foot of the bank at the jetty's west end and leans up and north-west for about 250 px of silk to a massive knobbed, pollarded head lying almost level at u 26800-27050 (v 515-650). From the knobs a fan of long thin whips spreads in every direction: west over the moored boat's bow, up to the street in front of 王家纸马铺 (v about 195) and east over the sheds' roofs. Bare whips drawn as fine lines without leaf masses (early spring); one trunk.
entities.vis: part: the crown overlaps the paper shop's yard, the sheds' roofs and the moored boat's bow; the foot is in the bank's wash
entities.note: MAIN POINT: base where the roots spread at the bank's foot, u 27045-27100, v 880-930 (root strokes at (27050-27060, 900-920) and (27060-27080, 870-900)); just east of it stand the jetty's west posts (u 27100-27140, v 770-850). Trunk outline: west edge (27000, 690) -> (27030, 760) -> (27050, 800) -> (27055, 880); east edge (27060, 650) -> (27080, 750) -> (27100, 830); girth about 55-60 px at v 720, bark knots at (27040-27060, 720-760). Knob head: dark knotted mass u 26790-27050, v 515-650, joined to the trunk's top at about (27000-27050, 600-650). Under the head's west half a rounded block of fine vertical hatch strokes (u 26840-26937, v 624-676) ends in a curved lower edge at about v 676: read as the head's underside resting on or just above the ground (custom point knob_foot). OTHER READING (that is why conf med): TWO trees: a short, massive pollard whose own trunk foot is that hatched block at about (26890, 676) (t8's range, u < 26900) carrying the knobbed head, plus this leaning trunk as a second willow whose top merges into the same head. Then t8 records the pollard and this entity keeps only the leaning trunk (base unchanged). The hatch could also be a low wattle fence at the tree's foot (structures_e's). The brief's hint 'trunk about 26700-26850, v 550-750' is the knob head: there is no upright trunk at u 26700-26850, where the moored boat's bow fills v 640-830. Whips west of about u 26550 may come from another tree further west; crown_w is the furthest whip that reads as continuous with this crown; top is the highest whip tip (the whips reach v 190-230 between u 26600 and 27050). SEAM WITH t8: the brief gave 'the great willow' to t8 by a guessed trunk position; by base it is t9's. If t8 recorded it too, keep one entity by the base reading. The restyle (east half) draws the same thing: one tree, trunk from the bank's foot, knobbed horizontal head, and paves the bank under it with flagstones (invented). Crops: scratchpad S2_t9/z1_willow.jpg, in_willow.jpg, z3_trunk_foot.jpg, z3_knob.jpg, z35_trunkmid.jpg, e_palisade.jpg, e_crown.jpg. Merge: t8 recorded the same tree as S2.tree.great_willow_27072 (retired as a duplicate; base (27072, 893), conf med, support bank slope): the trunk runs down the bank to roots at the water's edge; its other reading is a tree on the bank top at (26990, 655). The brief's trunk at 26700-26850 is the west end of the 250 px knobbed head. river_e puts the shore about 150 px lower than the roots (so the roots stand on the bank slope, not in the water). S2.str.wattle_fence_26890 (structures_e) is the hatched block under the head that t9 reads as a possible knob foot or second pollard.

Pole ends (27143, 283) and (27250, 305); faint hanging strokes at both ends (27145-27155, 285-310) and (27245-27250, 300-315). entities.name: tall frame of poles and ladders in the yard east of 王家纸马铺
entities.what: A tall open framework of long poles standing free in the yard east of the paper shop: a big ladder-like A-frame at the west (two railed ladders leaning together, apex about (27415, 105)), several tall poles crossing near the eaves of the building row behind, long beams laid across them at v about 150-230, and a cross-braced A-frame at the east (apex about (27598, 120)); no roof or cover. A timber or drying frame (or a builder's scaffold) whose yard below is empty.
entities.vis: part: its tops overlap the roofs at the silk's top; its north legs hidden
entities.note: Strokes: front leg feet in bays (from zoom 2-3 crops; the poles cross so densely that single legs are hard to follow, about ±10 px); long beams (27300, 145) -> (27560, 180) and (27270, 210) -> (27620, 215); apexes (27415, 105) and (27598, 120). The north corners are placeholders (the north legs are hidden behind the front ones), so the frame's depth is a builder's choice. Kind: recorded as a free-standing prop (rack/frame) because the brief names it but gives it to nobody; if structures_e reads it as a scaffold fixed to the building behind (whose eaves it reaches at v 100-130), it is part of that building and this entity is dropped. The trestle (S2.prop.trestle_board_27310) and the low stand (S2.prop.low_stand_27500) stand at its west end and under it. THE YARD UNDER IT IS EMPTY on the scan (u 27300-27620, v 300-450, checked at zoom 2-3 on plain and contrast-stretched crops): the restyle's crowd of about twelve (eight or nine at v 330-440, two by the frame, one in red, a rider) is invented. SCALE CUE: about 200 px from the leg feet (v 300) to the apexes, at least four times the porter's 49 px at v 328. Crops: S2_t9/z2_frame.jpg, z3_frame_w.jpg, z3_frame_e.jpg, e_frame.jpg, inspect_27420_180.jpg, e_yard_e.jpg. Second pass (east, left to east-middle): a head-like shape among the poles at the frame's east end (u 27540-27563, v 240-263) is unreadable on the scan (n_framefig.jpg; the restyle paints a man in a white cap), and the east-middle pass read no people in the yard (27240-27640, v 90-330). No figure recorded.
